title: test(spec): pin the OpenAPI WRITE-refusal test on the generator's diagnostic
body:
Fixes #18591

Clause-②: no

`refuses to WRITE the artifact when the document is inconsistent`
(`packages/spec/scripts/openapi-self-consistency.test.ts`) asserted only a non-zero exit
status and a missing artifact. **A subprocess that never starts satisfies both**, so the
case stayed green in exactly the scenario where the gate it exists to pin never ran once.

The fix is the shape its three sibling spawn tests already carry: assert the generator's
own diagnostic text as well. Test file only, 8 lines added, nothing else touched.

## Which text to assert — measured, not assumed

The claim comment could not say what the generator actually prints for the injected
`ApiErrorTypo` ref. The mutated generator was run once and read:

```text
Error: OpenAPI document is not self-consistent: 1 unresolvable $ref(s).
  - #/components/schemas/ApiErrorTypo  (referenced at components.schemas.Broken)
  defined components.schemas: [CreateRequest, UpdateRequest, SingleRecordResponse,
  ListRecordResponse, DeleteResponse, ApiError, BulkRequest, BulkResponse, BaseResponse, Broken]
```

So the sibling's pair does apply verbatim, and both halves are now asserted:
`toMatch(/unresolvable \$ref/)` and `toContain('#/components/schemas/ApiErrorTypo')`.

## Acceptance controls

Probe: park `node_modules/.pnpm/tsx@4.23.12` aside, so `npx tsx` resolves the pnpm shim
and the shim's target is gone — the generator subprocess never starts. Proven in effect
before any result was read (`npx tsx --version` exit 1, `Cannot find module …/tsx/dist/cli.mjs`),
restored under a `trap … EXIT INT TERM` with absolute paths and proven byte-identical after
each leg (same inode 689295, same tar-stream sha256 `e8d303f8…67e6`).

### LIT — the red leg

Same command both times: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 scripts/openapi-self-consistency.test.ts`

| tsx parked | file counts | `refuses to WRITE …` |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **before** (`2085be2b2d`) | `Tests  8 failed \| 13 passed (21)` | **PASSED** — the vacuous pass |
| **after** (`cd4904d361`) | `Tests  9 failed \| 12 passed (21)` | **FAILED** |

The new failure, in full:

```text
FAIL  |local| scripts/openapi-self-consistency.test.ts > build-openapi.ts end to end >
  refuses to WRITE the artifact when the document is inconsistent
AssertionError: expected 'node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1386…' to match /unresolvable \$ref/
```

All nine spawn tests in the file now go red under the probe; before this change, eight did.

### DARK — normal tree

| tsx in place | result |
|:---|:---|
| **before** (`2085be2b2d`) | `Test Files  1 passed (1)` · `Tests  21 passed (21)` |
| **after** (`cd4904d361`) | `Test Files  1 passed (1)` · `Tests  21 passed (21)` |

Nothing reddened. Whole package at `cd4904d361`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` →
`Test Files  485 passed | 1 skipped (486)` · `Tests  14015 passed | 1 skipped (14016)`, exit 0.
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` → exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck`,
`check:test-typecheck`; the test-typecheck debt ledger did not move).

## Changeset — measured

`npm pack --dry-run --json` in `packages/spec` at `cd4904d361`: **275** published entries,
**0** of them under `scripts/`, so the changed file is not in this package's `files[]`.
Positive control on the same reading: `src/**/*.zod.ts` is present (`src/ai/agent.zod.ts`, …),
so the instrument is live. Nothing published moves ⇒ no changeset is owed; `skip-changeset`
applies and is declared, not omitted.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran …` at `cd4904d361`:
56 derived families — **51 run exit 0**, **5 NOT MEASURED** (recorded exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`:
`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`,
`check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:type-check-debt`). All five read a built `dist/`
across the workspace and refuse without one; this diff emits nothing to any `dist/`, so they are
CI's closure-build run, not a red. Dependency-closure build (`--filter '@objectstack/spec^...'`)
is an empty run: `packages/spec` has no workspace dependencies.

`eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the changed file: 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
The repo-wide `pnpm lint` sweep is CI's run. Invariance leg, quoted from `eslint.config.mjs`'s
own header: "this repo runs one `eslint.config.mjs`, which never enables type-aware linting
(no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules) for ANY file" — so this diff
cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The universe count was not measured, so this is a
targeted run, not a proven narrowing.

## Acceptance notes

- Swept the repo for the same vacuous shape: `git grep "status).not.toBe(0)" -- '*.test.ts'`
  returns 9 hits across 4 files; the 5 outside this file each carry an output assertion on the
  adjacent line, so no second instance of this defect class exists in that spelling. Observation,
  not a card.
- `runGenerator()` could immunise the whole spawn family structurally by refusing a launch
  failure once, instead of each case re-deriving it from diagnostic text. Out of scope here —
  the card prescribes the siblings' shape and forbids inventing one — and moot for this file
  now that all nine spawn cases assert output. Noted, not filed.
